name: Bamboo Warrior

gist.Xiong, the Bamboo Guardian: High Attack; when he defeats a target with an attack he takes a card from either discard pile into his hand.
gist.Bamboo Staff: Equipment: once per turn, when a card returns from his discard pile to his hand, it hits a target for its hero's base Attack.
gist.Bamboo Shield: Expensive reaction that cancels damage to a hero; once it has come back from the discard pile it is cheap. One per turn.
gist.Critical Strike: An attack for twice the hero's Attack.
gist.Quick Attack: A free first attack each turn.
gist.Hammer Throw: Makes your next artifacts cost you cards.
gist.Thieving Strike: Attack that steals a hand card.
gist.Whirlwind Strike: Hits two heroes; needs Fighting three.
gist.Nicolas, the Hidden Alchemist: Potion draws; potions in the main deck.
gist.Cute Nerd Magenta: Discards a card to put any card from the deck into the discard pile, for Xiong to fetch.

plan: One fighter and a recycling loop. Xiong attacks; every kill lets him take a card back from a discard pile, usually a Bamboo Shield, which is then cheap, and every card that comes back makes a Bamboo Staff hit again. Magenta stocks the discard pile, Nicolas adds potions. Shields answer one hit a turn. All the damage is Xiong, and the loop only starts once he has killed something.

looks.early: Xiong with a Bamboo Staff, Fighting climbing.
looks.mid: A Shield cancelling your best hit each turn, Staffs pinging as cards return.
looks.late: Critical Strike on a stunned hero.

opening.tell: Xiong does all the attacking and has not killed anything yet.
opening.why: His loop needs a first kill, and a creatureless deck offers only heroes: a frozen Xiong is the whole deck switched off.

midgame.tell: He holds a Bamboo Shield, which cancels one hit on a hero per turn.
midgame.why: One cancel a turn does not stop three Storm ticks: keep ticking, shield Xiong's one big attack, Tea the stun back.

crisis.tell: Two Bamboo Staffs are equipped and Shields keep returning from his discard pile.
crisis.why: Fire Bomb takes the Staffs, and White Eye discards put the Shields back at full price.

endgame.tell: Xiong is down or frozen and the others do not attack.
endgame.why: Nicolas and Magenta have no damage of their own.

opening.board: Lucas equips a Bamboo Staff to Xiong and levels Fighting.
Magenta drops a Bamboo Shield into the discard pile for later.
